nodes.summary: The labelled transition system on worlds `ℕ`, with a single label, whose transitions are the listed edges.
nodes.title: Kripke structure as a transition system

nodes.summary: The input decodes to `(n, edges, worldVals, start, tokens)`, where `worldVals` lists the atoms true at each world; the answer is whether the structure is well formed and total (every world below `n` has a successor below `n`) and every infinite path from `start` satisfies the decoded formula.
nodes.title: LTL model checking as a decision problem

nodes.summary: Each of the three decision problems below, with the formula given by its linear-size token encoding, is in PSPACE, and every problem in PSPACE reduces to it by a polynomial-time many-one reduction:
nodes.title: Satisfiability, validity and model checking of LTL are PSPACE-complete

nodes.summary: The input decodes to a token list, which decodes to an LTL formula over atoms in `ℕ`; the answer is whether some infinite word over sets of atoms satisfies it.
nodes.title: LTL satisfiability as a decision problem

nodes.summary: The input decodes to a token list, which decodes to an LTL formula over atoms in `ℕ`; the answer is whether every infinite word over sets of atoms satisfies it.
nodes.title: LTL validity as a decision problem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
